english.note: Use this when the enthusiasm shows itself as active effort, participation, or motivation.
Use this when the motivated person is showing initiative and taking an active approach, especially at work or in a project.
Use this when active means energetically taking action or applying oneself, rather than simply moving around.

examples.english: You’re being really enthusiastic and proactive this time.

examples.english: They are very motivated in the project and take the initiative to discuss collaboration.
examples.traditional: 佢喺個計劃入面好積極，主動搵人傾合作。
